verses.text: “So remember Me; I will remember you.”

end.text: 9 horns in 20 minutes. What did he learn?
end.gold: Tonight in traffic: before the horn, one SubhanAllah.

captions: 5:42 p.m. The ferry queue. Wipers. Brake lights.
Someone cuts in. Horn. Again. Again.
The ramp closes. You missed it by one car.
Then, from the back seat, a small voice: “Move, idiot!”
Your son. Five years old. Copying you, word for word.
The next ferry. 6:30 p.m. Forty minutes lost. Nothing else.
You kneel next to him. “Baba was wrong. Say it with me.”
Thirty-three times, all the way across.

post.caption:
9 horns in 20 minutes. Not one “SubhanAllah.” 🤍

5:42 p.m., the ferry queue in the rain. Someone cuts in — horn, again, again. “Move, idiot!” You miss the boat by one car. Then a small voice from the back seat: “Move, idiot!” Your son, five years old, copying you word for word.

“So remember Me; I will remember you.” (2:152)

Tonight in traffic: before the horn, one SubhanAllah.
